mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_ROOMS(name, room_type, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES(#{name}, #{roomType}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM CHAT_ROOMS WHERE room_type = 'PRIVATE' AND ( (created_by = #{userId1} AND id IN (SELECT chat_room_id FROM USER_CHAT_ROOMS WHERE user_id = #{userId2})) OR (created_by = #{userId2} AND id IN (SELECT chat_room_id FROM USER_CHAT_ROOMS WHERE user_id = #{userId1})) )
